title: The Hungry Choir
author: Lena Joubert
blurb: Elodie Blackwood, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
